Plugin.Name: unMotion
Plugin.Overview: Clone VMs locally, migrate between paired Unraid hosts, and maintain scheduled ZFS replicas with coordinated manual recovery. Cold Move and Warm Move support ZFS and sparse file transfers; Warm Move requires a powered-off final cutover. Replication requires dedicated ZFS storage. Recovery requires Guest Agent evidence and a reachable, fenced source. No live migration or automatic failover. Keep verified backups and install matching versions on both hosts.
